purpose: Teach: 年度末/社債/付け加える/構える/済ませる/終日/折っ/心がける

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 年度末、決算、しっかり締めろ。
lines.en: Year-end closing and accounts settlement — handle it properly.
lines.style: Brief, authoritative opening. Sharp consonants. No room for negotiation. Eyes steady on the recipient. Direct, measured pace. The tone of someone accustomed to being listened to.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社債、発行計画、進めています。
lines.en: Yes, sir. We're moving forward with the corporate bond issuance plan.
lines.style: Respectful nod in the voice. Steady, businesslike delivery. Professional distance maintained but not cold. Reports facts cleanly without embellishment. Alert posture in the tone.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 資料に、注釈、もう少し付け加える必要がある。
lines.en: The materials need more annotations added to them.
lines.style: Observation delivered as instruction. Slight pause before 'more' — not critical, just precise. Even tone. The voice of someone who knows what clarity requires. No softening.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新事業、しっかり構えるつもりです。
lines.en: Yes. We're prepared to handle the new division with proper structure.
lines.style: Quiet assurance in the reply. Speaks to show he's understood the standard being set. Measured, professional tempo. Slight emphasis on 'prepared' — not defensive, just confirmatory. Stands firm.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 残務、今日中に、済ませるよう。
lines.en: Outstanding work must be completed by end of today.
lines.style: Final, non-negotiable. Crisp attack on each clause. No rising inflection at the end — a statement, not a question. The voice of deadline enforcement. Composed but unmovable.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。終日、会議室を使用しています。
lines.en: Understood. We're using the meeting room all day to ensure we finish.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact confirmation. Shows the preparation is already in motion. Steady, no apology in the tone. Reports capability. Quick, efficient delivery. Professional and ready.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 書類、折って、ファイルに収めろ。
lines.en: File all documents properly — fold them and store them securely.
lines.style: Practical instruction, final detail. Clipped, sequential delivery like checking items. Not harsh, just efficient. The voice of someone managing logistics with precision. Slight emphasis on each task.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。安全、心がけるよう、社員に伝えています。
lines.en: Understood. I've already briefed the staff on maintaining safety protocols throughout.
lines.style: Concluding statement with quiet competence. Shows initiative and attention to what matters. Steady, professional close. Neither rushed nor lingering. The tone of someone wrapping up with all bases covered.
